code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Extend each nonzero, non-background marker along both diagonals; preserve the 2x2 blocks.
    seeds=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                if g[rr][cc]==0: g[rr][cc]=v
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(code)
